title: Session mixes identity fields with an upload buffer, and carries a generic clamp

must_find.why: Owner and IsExpired use userID/expiresAt while Append, Remaining and Advance use buffer/cursor; two classes share one struct
a general integer clamp is attached to Session as a method although it has no business knowing about sessions

must_not_find.why: clamp's three arguments are the shape of a clamp; its placement, not its arity, is the defect
expiry takes the current time as an argument and is fully testable
